scope: Explicit Windows exclusive-append disk-world source candidate; native acceptance is a separate gate.

plan.encoding: ASCII canonical TSV with final LF

schema_catalog.position: after root and before decryption when present

plan.selection_and_dependencies: Preserve existing bounded all/map/tile dependencies and coordinate spelling.
plan.version_selection: Explicit Windows storage selects v7 before catalog or optional offmesh; older storage preserves older version selection.

admission.client_commands: Windows x86_64, 64-bit, MSVC and explicit windows-msvc-seal-v2 feature; actual native AMD64 gate and loaded sealed producer before key/client/scratch/output I/O.
admission.unsupported: product_disk_unsupported before key/client/scratch/output I/O; plan parsing is permitted
admission.verify: Native AMD64 and supported target/feature admission precede output I/O; no client, keys, scratch or loaded-producer seal required.

scratch.namespace: Fresh private exclusive namespace for each unfinished collision attempt.
scratch.resume: Verify sealed components, rerun unfinished producers with a fresh scratch namespace and replay exact retained artifact receipts.

identities.plan: SHA-256 of all canonical TSV bytes, including storage, all seven budgets, catalog and optional offmesh records.
identities.source: Existing authenticated forever-logical-collection-v1 identity; not physical availability or a complete archive snapshot.
identities.producer: Actual loaded PE through the explicit MSVC-v2 contract; not publisher authentication.
identities.keys: Key values, names, counts, hashes and paths remain excluded from CLI JSON, public plans and package context.

verification.scope: Existing intrinsic artifact integrity/formats and explicit plan context, including optional exact offmesh sources.

failure_envelope: forever-product-v7 after valid plan admission; generic pre-admission errors retain forever-product-v1; path-free stable codes.
